errors.text_span: Стълбовете са разделени на два типа - сини стълбове, които представляват общия брой на осигурените лица, и тънки черни линии, които представят относителния дял.
errors.evidence: The chart is a combination chart with blue bars and a black line. The description incorrectly states that the chart has two types of bars ('стълбове'), misclassifying the line chart as a type of bar.
The highest value for the number of insured persons is in 2019 (214,129), not 2018.
The lowest value for the number of insured persons is in 2013 (134,758), not 2009.

errors.text_span: Относителния дял варира от 5,3% през 2009 г. до 7,7% през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The range described for the relative share is incorrect. The minimum value is 5.2% in 2013 (not 5.3% in 2009), and the maximum value is 7.7% in 2019 (not 2018). The value for 2018 is 7.1%.
The description incorrectly states there are no visual accents, but there is a prominent vertical black line separating the data for 2014 and 2015.
The label for the right vertical axis is 'относителен дял %' (singular), not 'относителни дял %' (plural).
The description fails to mention that the black line representing the relative share is dashed.
